notes.title: Chapter 3 Update
notes.content: [h3]Dear players:[/h3][p]Thank you for your continued support and love! To make our romantic visual novel journey even more exciting, "Sapphire" is about to usher in a brand new chapter—Chapter 3. This time, we'll bring you a brand new storyline, a captivating new heroine, and a wealth of beautiful game artwork, making the world even more vibrant and colorful![/p][p][/p][h3]\[Update Content][/h3][h3]1. New Chapter: Chapter 3[/h3][list][*][p]Explore a deeper plot and immerse yourself in the emotional entanglements between the characters.[/p][/*][/list][h3]2. New Heroine: Sapphire[/h3][list][*][p]This new heroine joins our world with a unique personality and background.[/p][/*][*][p]Her story will bring new emotional twists to the hero. Is it a destined encounter, or just a fleeting encounter?[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]Look forward to the sparks that spark between her and the hero![/p][/*][/list][h3]3. New and Beautiful Art[/h3][list][*][p]Chapter 3 includes a large number of high-quality screenshots and background illustrations.[/p][/*][*][p]The meticulously designed character portraits and scene images bring the entire game world to life.[/p][/*][/list][h3]4. Optimization and Adjustments[/h3][list][*][p]We've optimized some storylines for a smoother and more natural experience.[/p][/*][*][p]We've fixed some known minor issues to improve overall game quality.[/p][/*][/list][h3]\[Acknowledgements][/h3][p]Thank you to every player for your support and companionship. Sapphire is even more exciting because of you. We remain committed to providing a better gaming experience and look forward to bringing you even more touching moments and surprises in future chapters.[/p][p]Whether you're a veteran or new player, this update will bring you a brand new story and visual experience. Come join the hero on his journey and discover your own romantic story together![/p][p]Action is worse than action! See you in Chapter 3![/p][p][/p][h2]Additional Note: Chapter 4 will be updated soon.[/h2]
